data.name: 8th period: Music
data.detailed_description:
"The exit is right there, if you can detect the strange noise."

"Your ears are the only thing you can rely on in this hallway where nothing should change."

"If you ignore that strange feeling, you'll never be able to leave."

"Take the ordinary path, or be drawn into another world."

The setting is the music room.

A drawing on the blackboard. A strange room where you hear a sound when you approach.

If you notice the correct strangeness and proceed, the exit will come into sight.

But what if you overlook it?

Or if you make the wrong choice?

This hallway will loop forever, trapping you.

Simple controls and intuitive exploration of the strangeness.

The player's hearing and sense of pitch will be put to the test.

Game Contents

- Use the sound and visuals to judge. If your answer is correct, proceed to 〇. If your answer is incorrect, proceed to X.

- If you get 8 correct answers in a row, you'll escape successfully.

- If your answer is incorrect, return to 0.

Game Controls

- Keyboard character control: WASD + Mouse view control

- Controller support: Left stick (D-pad) for character control + Right stick for view control

- Reducing view movement reduces motion sickness.

- Pause menu settings and language changes with keyboard or controller select.

Questions

Q: There's noise on the screen!

A: Please change the vertical synchronization and image quality settings.

Q: I was able to jump using the spacebar.

A: It doesn't have any particular meaning.

Q: Off-screen...

A: It's just for fun, since an alternate dimension wouldn't be interesting.

Q: I failed to get perfect pitch.

A: There are also note lengths, such as quarter notes and half notes.

Q: There are no illustrations of the instruments! There are no translations.

A: It can't be helped, since they're folk instruments.

[Live Commentary/Streaming Terms]

As long as you abide by the following terms, both individuals and corporations are allowed to stream gameplay videos.

- Monetization through video site features (ad revenue, tips, etc.) is allowed.

- Game commentary/streaming content that contains defamatory content or violates public order and morals is prohibited.

- Any illegal acquisition, modification, or tampering with the game's program or data is prohibited.

- MEYOSOFT assumes no responsibility for any damage or problems arising from game commentary/streaming.

- The guidelines are subject to change and update at any time. Please check the latest guidelines before posting.

We may take measures such as deleting or suspending broadcasts that do not comply with the guidelines or that are otherwise deemed inappropriate. If requested, please delete or suspend the broadcast without delay.
